question: In a certain code language, 'SINGER' is coded as '96' and 'CRACK' is coded as '104'.How will 'JACKAL' be coded in that language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e81f3ed21fddc72dd7e74439132a9341e1cd67dad9da66ee032ef789862eab.png] The logic followed here is: Logic: Sum of the place value of opposites of all letters + Number of letters in a word = Code of the word. 'SINGER' is coded as '96'. Opposite of SINGER is HRMTVI ⇒ (8+ 18 + 13 + 20 + 22 + 9) + 6 = 96.
